name: Sarru
talent_text: While in combat, the Moon will cycle through its phases every 5s. There are 8 Moon phases.\nStarting from a New Moon, all damage you deal will be Amplified by 5%. The value of the Amplifier will increase by 5% each phase until reaching 25% during a Full Moon, then it will decrease as the Moon returns to being a New Moon, restarting the cycle.\nDuring a Full Moon, deploying a Decoy will grant it Overcharge and the cycle will pause for 10s.
source: Ubisoft Y8S3.1 patch notes and the Division wiki
